notes.title: Update notes for version 0.8.9.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a "Malignant Medal" might not drop correctly when completing a Ritual
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple weapon reload events were queued and caused issues
[*] Fixed a base damage / multiplier calculation order bug
[*] Max damage of explosions towards the player is now 70 hitpoints
[*] Game now pauses if window loses focus
[*] "Vomit-type" enemies now display correct vomit effects, with more visible colors
[*] Various tweaks to meta upgrade pricing
[*] "Deadly Dash" upgrade damage output greatly increased
[*] "Range -20%" debuff removed from "Spread Shot" lvl. 1 upgrade
[*] Minor grammar fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for version 0.8.8.0
notes.content:
This update introduces fixes to the following issues:
[list]
[*] Fix for crash in Meliora boss fight, if the boss is defeated during the laser beam anticipation frames
[*] Fix for a bug where Maidens of Cessation could be defeated by activating the final pedestal. While this was clever use of game mechanics, this was not the intended way to defeat them.
[*] Fix for bug where auto aim keybind was not saved to settings file correctly.
[*] Various fixes to reload mechanism, including the fact that the reload indicator now reflects the amount of actual amount of bullets available
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for version 0.8.7.0
notes.content:
We have released an update that addresses some of the bugs reported by our players on the EA launch date:

[list]
[*] Potential fix for issue, where in rare situations no arrow to the latest objective is shown and the objective pole cannot be activated
[*] Fixed a bug, where the player could take damage during a ritual completion scene
[*] Fixed an issue, where the graphical effects, such as darkness near objectives, were only shown for the first objective
[*] Fixed an issue, where the current auto fire setting was not correctly shown in the settings menu
[*] Fixed a bug, where the weapon clip could be half empty when starting a ritual with an active effigy affecting its size
[/list]

notes.title: LETIFER is OUT NOW on Steam Early Access!

We are delighted to announce that Letifer is out on Steam Early Access. 

We’ve worked long and hard to make the game as good as possible and are very interested in hearing your feedback to make the upcoming 1.0 release even better! 

Hit us up on the Steam Community page or in our Discord channel!

notes.title: Letifer will release on Early Access, 17th of April 2025!
notes.content:
Hello people!

We are delighted to announce that Letifer will release on Steam Early Access 17th of April, 2025!

The Early Access version will already give the players a substantial amount of content, as the game will be playable from start to finish! Those that have played the demo will find that the upcoming release has undergone many improvements, both big and small :)

We are grateful for all the feedback we have already received and we hope you will continue to give us plenty more as we move forward!

See you on the battlefields!

-
Third Spirit Games

notes.title: Letifer is taking part in the Raid Survivors Festival!
Letifer demo has been updated!
notes.content:
First of all, a big thank you to everyone who has already played the Letifer demo. We appreciate all the feedback you have given us so far and so this update will have many changes that you have asked for. 

The update 1.1.0.0 introduces many quality of life updates, and a bit of new functionality as well. Also, earlier we patched in the option for Auto-Aim, due to many requests for it. Now have implemented option for Auto-Fire, also heavily requested.

Please continue giving us feedback, so we can make the game even better! 

You can also join us in our Discord channel at https://discord.gg/thirdspiritgames if you want to discuss about the update and potential ideas for future development more in detail.

---

Here are the patch notes for update:  

- Bunch of upgrade balancing:
[list]
    - Damage debuff removed from Spread fire
    - Damage greatly buffed on Deadly Dash
    - Drone Grenade Field starting size buffed 
    - Drone Slowing Field received a small nerf, due to being a bit too overpowered.
    - Blood Sacrifice no longer causes occasional damage to the player
    - Rebalanced Magnetism upgrades
[/list]
- Supply boxes can now drop additional powerups, with varying effects
- Added option for analogue gamepad movement, which is now the default option
- Added optional auto-fire setting
- Auto-aim now aims towards lootboxes too
- When using a gamepad, auto-aim can now be overridden on the fly, by aiming with manual input
- Level up flash effect toned down
- Default master volume set at 80%
- Multiple stacks of bloodclot now have their own sprite
- Added drops when trees are destroyed
- Added drops to minibosses
- Bunch of bug fixes, both big and small
